title: Kiɗa
lead: Ƙirƙiri waƙoƙi da kiɗan kayan kiɗa a kan na’urar Turai guda da ke aiki da hira.
noModels: Babu samfurin kiɗa da ake samu a yanzu.
lyricsPlaceholder: Bar shi babu komai don kiɗa ba tare da kalmomi ba. Alamun sashe kamar [Verse] da [Chorus] suna tsara waƙar.
seedHint: Yi amfani da iri ɗaya don kwatanta canje-canjen buƙata cikin adalci.
signInPrompt: Ƙirƙirar kiɗa tana samuwa ga masu asusu.
jobsEmpty: Waƙoƙinka suna bayyana anan. Ana ajiye su a kan sabar na ’yan kwanaki, don haka ka sauke waɗanda kake son ajiyewa.
